scope: Bounded V2 multi-consumer capture in dskit/pipeline/trust.py: a single PUBLISHED root may be captured by more than one distinct consumer document (distinct consumer port), each producing one CAPTURED receipt, while the legacy v1 linear chain and one-time CONSUMED are unchanged.
non_goals: multi-CAPTURED on the legacy v1 chain
relaxing one-time CONSUMED or sharing handles/sessions across consumers
the F3 composed-tape verification itself (follow-on slice that consumes this seam)

seam.edit_1: remove the P4-blanket `_require_unclaimed` call from `_require_head` (trust.py:1821); `_require_unclaimed` stays and still governs the legacy capture path (via `_legacy_gate` at 5054 and the v1 view/append paths at 432/2140).
seam.edit_2: `_validate_capture_request` (trust.py:2441): after the existing legacy-capture refusal (2438) and `_recover`, require (a) v1 head is PUBLISHED and (b) the incoming capture's consumer_document_sha256 differs from every prior P4 capture committed for that stream.
seam.edit_3: `_published_for_descriptor` (trust.py:2117) freeze path now permits a P4-captured-but-v1-PUBLISHED stream (head check alone still blocks legacy-CAPTURED/CONSUMED streams).
seam.distinct_key: consumer_document_sha256 (the frozen document identity), NOT the four-field port. Same document reaching the same root through any node/input/purpose still names one consumer and refuses. Prior (stream, consumer_document_sha256) pairs are derived read-only from committed P4 entries (fingerprint entry[2] -> captures[i][2] port dict -> its consumer_document_sha256; audit entry[3] -> streams[i] == stream).

invariants: one CAPTURED receipt per distinct consumer document per PUBLISHED root
same (stream, consumer_document_sha256) captured twice -> duplicate refusal, including same-document-different-node/input
legacy v1 chain remains single-CAPTURED per stream
P4<->legacy capture of the same stream remain mutually exclusive
one-time CONSUMED per consumer session unchanged
distinct-document check runs under the ledger lock (atomic, no TOCTOU)

cases: same stream + same consumer_document_sha256 across two batches
same document reaching the same root via a different consumer_node/consumer_input
same document sha but different run/nonce
P4 capture of a legacy-CAPTURED stream
legacy capture of a P4-captured stream
v1 receipt append behind a P4 stream
second legacy CAPTURED on one stream
same port raced concurrently -> one winner
same admission replayed -> idempotent same record

forbidden_effects: no new mutable state outside the immutable _root/ledger
no v1 receipt shape / descriptor / planner / __all__ / purity change

tests.new: tests/pipeline/test_captured_authorization.py (or new test_multiconsumer_capture.py): two distinct consumer documents capture the same publication -> both succeed with independent records/sessions; same-port second capture refuses; freeze against a P4-captured publication succeeds; all negative families.

implementation_files: dskit/pipeline/trust.py (3 seam edits + a read-only _p4_stream_ports derivation)
